'''Paul Wilkins''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Washington State Championship]] on 21 April 2001 with Alderaan Ops & OMDH (with Palace Raiders), according to Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2149">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-25-wa-state-championship-4-21-01d2149/ wa-state-championship-4-21-01], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 25 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-25-wa-state-championship-4-21-01d2149/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
